ayahs.1: The Rahman—mercy that encompasses all creation in this life.
ayahs.2: He taught the Qur'an—guidance spoken into the world as a gift flowing from the Rahman's favour.
ayahs.3: He created humanity—your very existence is itself among His greatest blessings.
ayahs.4: and taught them speech—every means of expression Allah placed in you.
ayahs.5: The sun and moon run by precise calculation.
ayahs.6: The stars and trees bow in submission to His laws.
ayahs.7: He raised the sky and set the balance of justice,
ayahs.8: so that you do not tip the scales.
ayahs.9: Weigh with equity and do not give short measure.
ayahs.10: He spread out the earth for all creatures.
ayahs.11: In it are fruits, date palms with sheathed clusters,
ayahs.12: grain in husks, and fragrant plants.
ayahs.13: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.14: He created humanity from sounding clay like pottery,
ayahs.15: and created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
ayahs.16: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.17: He is Rabb of the two easts and the two wests.
ayahs.18: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.19: He merged the two seas—they meet yet do not cross a barrier between them.
ayahs.20: Between them is a barrier neither can transgress.
ayahs.21: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.22: From both seas come pearls and coral.
ayahs.23: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.24: His are the ships with raised sails, sailing the seas like mountains.
ayahs.25: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.27: Only the Face of your Rabb—full of Majesty and Honour—will remain forever.
ayahs.28: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.29: All in the heavens and earth ask of Him. Every day He is engaged in some matter.
ayahs.30: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.31: We will attend to you, O two weighty multitudes—humans and jinn.
ayahs.32: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.33: O assembly of jinn and humans: If you can pass beyond the realms of the heavens and earth, then do so—but you cannot except by authority from Allah.
ayahs.34: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.35: Flames of fire and molten metal will be sent against you, and you will not be able to defend one another.
ayahs.36: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.37: When the sky splits apart, becoming rose-red like burnt oil—
ayahs.38: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.39: On that Day no human or jinn will be asked about their sins—the record already speaks.
ayahs.40: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.41: The guilty will be known by their marks and seized by their foreheads and feet.
ayahs.42: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.43: This is the Hell the wicked used to deny.
ayahs.44: They will move between it and scalding water.
ayahs.45: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.46: For whoever stood in awe of appearing before their Rabb—there are two Gardens.
ayahs.47: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.49: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.50: In each are two flowing springs.
ayahs.51: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.52: In each are two kinds of every fruit.
ayahs.53: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.54: They will recline on couches lined with brocade, with fruit within easy reach.
ayahs.55: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.56: In both are companions of modest gaze, untouched before by any human or jinn.
ayahs.57: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.59: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.60: Is the reward for ihsan—worshipping as though you see Allah—anything but ihsan?
ayahs.61: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.62: Below these two are two more Gardens.
ayahs.63: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.64: Both Gardens are of deep, lush green—shade and abundance beyond anything this dunya offers.
ayahs.65: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.66: In each are two gushing springs.
ayahs.67: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.68: In both are fruits, date palms, and pomegranates.
ayahs.69: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.70: In them are noble companions of fine character and beauty.
ayahs.71: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.72: Companions of gorgeous eyes, reserved in pavilions.
ayahs.73: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.74: Untouched before by any human or jinn.
ayahs.75: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.76: Reclining on green cushions and splendid carpets.
ayahs.77: So which of your Rabb's favours will you both—humans and jinn—deny?
ayahs.78: Blessed is the Name of your Rabb, full of Majesty and Honour.
